name: What factors should I consider when choosing a design for my built-in shelving?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a design for my built-in shelving?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a design, consider the room's function and existing aesthetic. Think about what you plan to store or display: books, media, decorative items, or a combination. This influences shelf depth, spacing, and whether you need open shelving, cabinets, or drawers. Material and finish choices should complement your current decor. Also, consider lighting; integrated lighting can highlight items and create ambiance. Finally, discuss your budget and long-term needs with your contractor, as these factors guide decisions on customization levels and materials for a functional and aesthetically pleasing result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider the room's function, items to store, existing aesthetic, materials, finishes, lighting, budget, and long-term needs when choosing a design.
